items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1954-06
items.q: The prophet found in Isaiah that he would be here in the way he would come.

ctx.x: In other words, you've maintained that Jesus had a point in pointing out the fact that the Son of Man, not necessarily that he didn't have a place, but it was, uh, more or less, maybe a lesson under the circumstances that he said it. That people might gain a lesson from his word.

Well, definitely, I believe that he had a point, but, uh, uh, I think the point was that, uh, he had came here in the form of a man in Jesus. And, uh, the world had received him not. As I heard a minister say that if the world had known it was really the Christ, he would have had a place to stay, but they didn't know. And of course, Why didn't they know? Well, because people don't believe. The prophet found in Isaiah that he would be here in the way he would come. Well, the folks don't believe. Just like today,…

Well, hey, don't you think that they would have believed if they would have read? Instead of taking the words of the priests and the elders and the scribes and the Pharisees, if individuals then, uh, we know that the, ratio of education was about 1,000% lower than ours in those days. Don't you think that the, the Jews as a nation would have known Jesus and would have recognized him as their savior and as the heavenly king if they would have read themselves?
